silhouette.reason: Reads as a big cat / tiger from the side and 3/4: level back, low head, deep chest, digitigrade legs, J-hanging tail with a black tip. The trunk is still long and tubular beside the Schönbrunn photos, the hind thigh shallow, and the ears read as thin cups: in hero.png the near ear is a pale disc and the far ear a black spike, so neither reads as a rounded tiger ear.
fixes: shorten the trunk masses ~5% and deepen the brisket in torso.ts so the waist tuck reads in side view
thicken the ear shell and round its rim in ears.ts so it keeps a rounded outline edge-on (no disc / spike at 3/4)
enlarge the hamstring/quadriceps masses in legs.ts so the haunch reads as a powerful thigh

proportions.reason: Sourced numbers hold in code (head+body ~1.96 m, tail ~0.99 m, withers ~1.0 m on the 2.2 × 0.5 × 1.0 m sheet). By eye beside photos the head is slightly small and low, the muzzle a touch long and the forearms thin for an Amur male.
fixes: thicken the forearm masses ~10% in legs.ts
shorten the muzzle 1 cm and widen the whisker pads in face.ts

materials.reason: Vertex colour on the plain strip: the coat reads as painted velvet, not fur. Stripes are crisp but their edges stair-step at the body cell; nose leather, eyes and claws separate by hue only, with no roughness split. No whiskers.
fixes: fur shells or cards along the hair flow on the back, ruff and tail (fur.ts) so the coat breaks light like fur
roughness split: wet nose leather and eyes glossy, coat fully rough
stripe colour on a finer head/body cell at LOD0 so stripe edges stop stair-stepping

detail.reason: Primary and secondary forms are there (scapula, haunch, hock point, toe beans, sheathed claws, lidded eyes, whisker-pad dots, ear ocelli, canines, belly fringe, ruff tufts), but in the portrait close-up there are no whiskers, no fur locks breaking the outline, and the face planes are soft.
fixes: whisker strands as thin tubes from the pads (face.ts)
fur locks on the ruff, elbows and belly as cards
sharper cheekbone and brow planes in face.ts

wear.reason: A clean zoo animal: no mud on the paws, no scars, no matted or wet fur, no dust; only a ground-occlusion grade.
fixes: grime the paws and lower legs with soil colour (grime with the ground mask)
a few seeded scars on the face/shoulders and a notch in one ear
damp, darker fur on the lower legs and belly fringe

lod.reason: LOD2 (2.9k tris) keeps the outline and the orange/white blocks, but the far view in sheet.png is visibly faceted, the legs are tubes and the stripes become random dark triangles, so the pattern shifts at the switch.
fixes: paint LOD2 stripes as 6–8 broad authored bands instead of sampling the LOD0 pattern per triangle
build LOD2 lower legs from the sculpt with a gentle inflate instead of tubes

technical.reason: QA PASS at every LOD; 136.9k / 27.2k / 2.9k triangles under the 150k / 30k / 3k budgets; 3 draws; one material; deterministic stripes.
fixes: move LOD0 triangles from the ears and claws (dense for what they show) to the face
merge each eye with its lids into one part per side
